data.fullPrompt: Remove Desk Chair completely. Remove Rolling Storage Cabinet completely. Remove Wall Letters completely. Remove Photo Garland completely. Keep soft powder blue walls exactly as-is. Keep beige loop carpet floor exactly as-is. Warm japandi interior. White oak, cream linen, terracotta clay, brushed brass. White lacquered platform storage bed anchors the room centered on back wall. Dark walnut floating nightstand mounted at 24-inch height on right side with aged brass pull and single drawer. Sand beige wool-blend area rug 5x7 feet extends under bed, anchoring the sleeping zone in foreground with subtle geometric texture. Matte black arc floor lamp 68 inches high positioned in left corner with aged brass socket and linen drum shade. Dark walnut vertical bookshelf 72 inches tall with four open shelves and matte black metal uprights stands right of bed in background. Framed abstract art with terracotta and ochre tones hangs above headboard. Sand beige linen duvet cover with two terracotta linen pillow shams, charcoal grey knit throw draped at footboard adds layered warmth. Ceramic vessel on nightstand provides neutral accent. Shot at eye level, 24mm equivalent, f/8, perfect exposure, professional architectural photography, photorealistic, Architectural Digest quality, no people, no text.
